rules.text: SikaBond®-150 Premium Floor is designed for full surface bonding of below floor coverings on absorbent and non-absorbent substrates in interior areas: Linoleum coverings Woven fabrics Natural fibre coverings with backing Single or multilayer needle felting Carpets with PVC, PU or filler-free backing Impact sound insulation underlays PVC and cushioned vinyl (CV) floor coverings Corkment and cork linoleum Rubber floor coverings as tiles (~3.5 mm, e.g
